history.summary: A Jal Devi (goddess of water) temple at Todaraisingh, listed by Justdial as 'MAA JAL Devi Mandir, Main Market Todarai Singh, Tonk' (rated 4.8 from 137 ratings) and by travel guides among the prominent temples of Tonk (the town listings conflate Tonk district and Todaraisingh). FLAG - CSV town 'Tonk' is the district, not the town; the rated, verifiable shrine is in Todaraisingh's main market. Possible overlap with seq 2115 ('Jaldevi Temple, Bavadi'), a thin placeholder whose only footprint was a devotional video tagged 'Bawadi, Todaraisingh' with an uncertain location - the two may be the same Todaraisingh Jal Devi shrine recorded under different locality names, but identity could not be confirmed, so this row is kept distinct; recommend Mahesh merge with seq 2115 if they prove identical. No published founding history. Coordinates are a Todaraisingh-town approximation.

name: Jaldevi Mandir, Todaraisingh
town: Toda Rai Singh (CSV says Tonk; actual town is Todaraisingh)
town_description: Toda Rai Singh (Todaraisingh) is an ancient, hill-surrounded town in Tonk district, Rajasthan, about 48 km from Tonk and 135 km from Jaipur. Noted for its archaeological significance, stepwells (Hadi Rani ki Baori, Isar Baori, Bhopat Baori) and over 50 historic temples, it is locally famous for 'ghatti, patti, bawdi, dawdi'.

travel.railway: Tonk has no railway station; nearest major railheads Jaipur (~135 km) and Sawai Madhopur (~85 km, verify)
travel.road: ~48 km from Tonk town by road; buses and taxis from Tonk and Jaipur
